interventions.detail: Installed CPU-only torch from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu before `uv pip install -e .`
Installed triton: megatron.core imports it unconditionally (moe/ops/paged_stash.py), not pulled by CPU torch
Installed transformers (needed by HuggingFaceTokenizer, only in training extra)
Pinned transformers<5: 5.x loads GPT-2 tokenizer with eos_token=None, so --append-eod crashes the worker and the main process hangs
Downloaded GPT-2 tokenizer files (tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, vocab.json, merges.txt) to /work/gpt2 via curl
